title: Pay the parking space levy
what: Pay the annual parking space levy on off-street parking spaces in the levy districts, as the owner at 1 July.

sources.title: Parking Space Levy Act 2009 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who, as at 1 July in any year, is the owner of leviable premises is liable for payment of the levy for the premises

reach.condition: if it owns leviable parking premises in a levy district
